exercises.q: Ожидания радостей ___ (усиливать / усиливаться).
exercises.why: Николай Лесков · Жемчужное ожерелье — Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье» (public domain). Explanations: the DLI Grammar Reference Book.  ·  «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Николай Лесков, «Жемчужное ожерелье».
